source.description:
Follow-ups from xtrm-hzb review + xtrm-2mi review residual, none blocking:

1. UNCERTAIN-replay gate routing (R2.7): decide and implement where 'uncertain blocks blind replay' is enforced — retry() currently supersedes obligations carrying unresolved pending_external_observations without consulting them; send-side uncertainty unrepresented. Either a guard in the ledger or an explicit caller/transport-layer contract.
2. Journal trust boundary: serialize appends at the store level (concurrent duplicate replied events are fold-tolerated but retained); validate obligation.opened.input payloads and public API inputs (currently z.record(unknown) / raw ZodError leaks).
3. Seam integration test: drive ChannelCommunicationService.reply() end-to-end with a ledger replyHandle() (unconfirmed handle request_message_id='' trips 6yn stream-scan — assert ordering contract).
4. Two-journal write atomicity (from 2mi review): if evidence.append throws after ledger.journal.append succeeded, a void lands without its evidence entry — reconcile-on-load or single-journal design.
5. Nit sweep: wrong_direction vs reply_not_expected_from naming alignment; settleFromStream bare catch{}; whole-projection reload equality assertion.
